title: Don’t waste your money on these lint spreader towels!
text: Don’t waste your money on these lint spreader towels!. When I drive by self with this towel after washing it first I had little pieces of blue fuzz everywhere they are garbage!!  Worst towels I’ve ever bought &  worst thing I’ve ever bought from Amazon!
